name: last_band_seed_matrix
caption: Last-band mean cosine-distance matrix among the ten domain seeds, one row per embedding. Diagonal is D_within. Occupancy map, not a cluster count. Computed in the original high-dimensional space.
alt_text: Last-band mean cosine-distance matrix among the ten domain seeds, one row per embedding. Diagonal is D_within. Occupancy map, not a cluster count. Computed in the original high-dimensional space.
limitations: Replication of the occupancy generate, not a restore of s5-lock-occupancy-20260905T164327Z-6780902f. Hosted sampling is not deterministic; level mismatch vs archival CIs is expected. Sign agreement (CI excludes 0) is the claim. Band 12 has n_within_pairs=6 and n_between_pairs=114 because four domain trajectories stop at turnover 11.75 (noise s2 FAILED; philosophy s1, programming s2, war s2 COMPLETED with 47 chunks). Band 10 still has the full 80/1440 pair set and also excludes 0; it is not the pre-registered F4 number. Do not impute missing last-band pairs. Do not replace archival 0.201 [0.065, 0.332]. Twin CIs are not headlined here.
